title: How to make friends as an adult
content: Friendship tends to form through a mix of proximity, repetition, and gradually opening up, seeing the same people regularly, like through a class, hobby group, or recurring activity, and sharing a bit more of yourself over time. That's why joining something ongoing tends to work better than one-off events, the repeated contact does a lot of the work on its own.
